brief_title: An Open Label Extension (OLE) Study to Evaluate Long-term Safety and Tolerability of Pelacarsen (TQJ230)
official_title: A Single Arm, Open Label Extension (OLE), Multicenter Study to Evaluate Long-term Safety and Tolerability of Pelacarsen (TQJ230) in Patients With Cardiovascular Disease Who Have Successfully Completed the Apheresis Parent Study.

primary_outcomes.measure: Incidence of Adverse events (AEs) or serious adverse events (SAEs), including changes in laboratory evaluations, vital signs qualifying and reported as AEs.

brief_summary: This non-randomized, open-label extension study provides post-trial access to pelacarsen (TQJ230) to participants in Germany with hyperlipoproteinemia(a) and established cardiovascular disease who have successfully completed the double-blind parent study (CTQJ230A12302). Study has been terminated by sponsor following the outcome of the Lp(a)HORIZON study (NCT04023552), which did not meet its primary endpoint

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Signed informed consent
* Participant has successfully completed the parent study and is considered safe to participate by Investigator's clinical judgement.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Any medical condition(s) that may put the participant at risk in the investigator's opinion
* Pregnant or nursing (lactating) women
* Women of child-bearing potential, unless they are using effective methods of contraception during dosing and for 16 weeks (= 5 times the terminal half-life) after stopping of study medication
